title: Luxury Seagrove Beach Vacation Home with Private Pool & Bikes
meta_description: Blue Brilliance of Seagrove offers a 4BR/4.5BA retreat for 12 guests with a private pool, bikes, and alfresco dining—steps from Seaside and 30A’s best beaches.
description_expanded: AboutCoastal Luxury in the Heart of Seagrove – 4 Bedroom Vacation Rental with Private Pool Near Seaside and the Beach Welcome to your dream vacation getaway in Seagrove Beach, Florida. This newly built luxury 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom vacation home sleeps 13 and is perfectly located close to the sugar-white sands of 30A—close to Seaside, Publix, dining, boutique shopping, and family-friendly entertainment. Designed for comfort, style, and relaxation, this spacious home features upscale coastal décor, two living rooms with smart TVs, ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom, a fully stocked kitchen, and a private gated pool with a sun shelf for lounging. Why Guests Love This Home: 4 Bedrooms | 4.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 13 • Private gated pool with sun shelf – perfect for sunbathing and splashing with little ones • Close to Seaside, beach access, Publix, dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment • Putting green • All bedrooms have ensuite bathrooms and flat-screen TVs • Primary king ensuite is located on the first floor • Two spacious living rooms – both with TVs for relaxing and movie nights • Open concept main living area with luxury coastal furnishings and smart TV • Back porch with dining table and lounge seating for outdoor meals and relaxing evenings • Four adult bikes and two children's bikes included for exploring 30A • Corn hole set for friendly backyard games • Portable pickleball set • Fun family games • Fully stocked kitchen with premium appliances, cookware, and dining essentials • Add a street-legal golf cart and receive 10% off the golf cart rental rate • Laundry center on both floors • Outdoor shower • Outdoor grill on covered porch overlooking pool • Large porches on front and back on home, back porch has adjustable privacy shades • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Amenity starter kit provided with shampoo, conditioner, bath soap, paper products, Starbucks coffee, and bottled waters • Ample parking – plenty of room for multiple vehicles Coastal Comfort and Elegant Design Step inside this thoughtfully designed Seagrove vacation rental and feel instantly at home. The open-concept floor plan brings the living, kitchen, and dining areas together for easy gathering and connection. The kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances, quartz countertops, a large island, and everything needed to prepare meals at home. Each of the four bedrooms is a private suite with its own bathroom, flat-screen TV, luxury bedding, and stylish décor. With two spacious living rooms—each with their own TV—there’s space for families and groups to spread out, relax, or entertain. Outdoor Living at Its Best The private gated pool with a sun shelf offers the perfect place to cool off, sunbathe, or play with the kids. The covered back porch features a dining table and lounge seating, ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Guests will love playing corn hole or biking to the beach and local hotspots using the included bikes. Unbeatable Location in Seagrove Beach Located close to beach access, Seaside, Publix, and 30A’s best dining and shopping, this home puts you at the center of it all. From live music and art galleries to farmers markets and beach days, there’s always something to explore nearby. Whether you're planning a family vacation, group getaway, or couples retreat, this luxury vacation rental in Seagrove Beach offers the perfect combination of modern comfort, upscale amenities, and prime location along Florida’s scenic 30A. Book your stay today and discover why guests return again and again to this coastal haven in the heart of Seagrove Beach.
